t: The Magnusson aluminium folding work platform provides a stable and spacious elevated surface for various trade tasks. With a generous platform, it offers ample working area, ideal for builders, decorators, and electricians needing a reliable platform. Its heavy-duty design supports up to 150kg, ensuring robust performance. This aluminium work platform folds flat for easy transport and storage, making it convenient for on-site jobs. Safety features include anti-slip feet and secure lockable steel hinges, providing stability during use.
